title: Valorant Clone
description: Request to create or develop a clone of Valorant, a popular multiplayer tactical first-person shooter game.
business_case_summary:
Business Case Summary: Valorant Clone (DEM-2026-0009)

Executive Summary
This project develops a clone of the popular multiplayer tactical FPS Valorant, mirroring the approved DEM-2026-0007 request in Gaming domain.

Direct Business Value/Impact
Capitalizes on high-demand FPS genre for user engagement and revenue, building on successful Gaming precedents like DEM-2026-0007.

Potential Risk Mitigation
High risk addressed via proven delivery of identical prior project (DEM-2026-0007, approved); apply lessons from low-risk DEM-2026-0004 for efficient scoping.
